authority_notice: New topology choices and complete-response integration are project decisions. ASCE source provisions retain their own applicability. These fixtures are independently derived bookkeeping/geometry checks, not a design qualification or an automatic sharing law.
reference_number_encoding: Exact integers or finite-decimal/numerator-denominator strings; no binary-float engineering authority.

numeric_policy.independent_integration_oracle: Direct unchanged dependency calls with independently assembled physical inputs; never adapter output as its own oracle.

constructive_hardware.notice: Feasible starting geometry only, not a passing strength design. Actual baseline geometry/fillets/hardware validation is mandatory. Controlled clearance-only preset tuning is permitted by the order; reference arithmetic stays unchanged.

source_absent_expected_behavior.nonzero: Geometry and required total foundation action remain available; unresolved branch/normal/shaft/contact demands remain SOURCE_REQUIRED or native compatible unavailable statuses; no automatic sharing.
source_absent_expected_behavior.zero: Zero transfer may be proven under explicit exclusion of self-weight/preload/pretension; no qualification or full-base adequacy claim.

checks.requirement: Verify full commit 99befa9780e7c7abf72c8a33e5eb45b9e368d916, count 118 in full history, clean active work area and origin/main/remote main equality.

checks.title: Twelve historical tags
checks.requirement: Verify all twelve prior annotated freeze identities and peeled targets; Stage 4.4 tag peels to the starting commit. Never invent tag-object hashes.

checks.title: Two-file integrity
checks.requirement: Read and SHA-256-check this matrix and order; verify all 120 requirements and 24 reference IDs and the final order sentinel.

checks.title: Applicable source review
checks.requirement: Verify supplied ASCE/SEI 74-23 and Erratum bytes, source locators and figures; record the distinction between standard provisions and project integration decisions.

checks.title: No stale stage restart
checks.requirement: Latest user-evidenced Stage 4.4 freeze supersedes the August handoff stopping point; reuse baseline source registries instead of requesting duplicate PDFs.

checks.title: One new physical product
checks.requirement: Expose one Moment Connections product WI_RHS_SRS_COLUMN_MOMENT_BASE_CONNECTION, contract 4.5-RC1; do not alter Stage 3.7 shear or Stage 4.4 L-column products.

checks.title: Three distinct profile families
checks.requirement: Use explicit WI, RHS hollow rectangular including square, and SRS solid rectangular including square identities; never infer solidity from a display name.

checks.title: Nine mode combinations
checks.requirement: Support each profile family with TWO_X, TWO_Y and FOUR_XY. For WI, X means broad web faces; Y means exterior flange faces. No invented envelope side-face.

checks.title: No unsupported expansion
checks.requirement: Reject angle/channel/circular/skewed/unequal-thickness/hybrid profile modes outside this RC1; no 316SS connector provider, concrete-capacity engine or full-column stability design.

checks.title: No unqualified capacity claim
checks.requirement: Biaxial action input and constructive geometry do not prove either 2-angle or 4-angle adequacy; no automatic 50/50 or quarter sharing.

checks.title: WI physical footprint
checks.requirement: Retain two flanges and web including native section/fillet identity; use actual section end footprint, not enclosing rectangle.

checks.title: Hollow footprint
checks.requirement: Retain near/far/side walls and cavity; compare square and nonsquare cases and never fill the cavity.

checks.title: Solid footprint
checks.requirement: Retain the continuous solid section; do not introduce artificial walls, cavity or arbitrary effective thickness.

checks.title: WI flange pair
checks.requirement: TWO_Y has one exterior connector per opposite flange, independent short member bolt groups and real rear-hardware web clearance.

checks.title: WI web pair
checks.requirement: TWO_X has opposite web-face connectors and a single common shank per matching bolt, not duplicated overlapping bolts.

checks.title: WI four angles
checks.requirement: FOUR_XY combines exterior flange pair and opposite web pair; check web-angle extent/feet against surrounding flanges and all other hardware.

checks.title: Box two angles
checks.requirement: RHS/SRS TWO_X or TWO_Y is an opposite exterior-face pair with common full-depth shanks and exterior terminal hardware.

checks.title: Box four angles
checks.requirement: RHS/SRS FOUR_XY has two opposite pairs; use the explicit nonintersecting elevation offsets in the constructive preset.

checks.title: Fifteen constructive examples
checks.requirement: One valid geometry for each of five section presets times three layouts is mandatory; approved clearance-only preset adjustments must retain topology and be recorded, not alter reference fixtures.

checks.title: Prepared nominal base
checks.requirement: Column lower end and connector foot undersides use the nominal foundation-top plane; no floating axial gap or hidden base plate; contact activity remains separately qualified.

checks.title: Pedestal containment
checks.requirement: Check real footprint, foot, anchor-hole/shank/embedment and hardware containment in the finite pedestal; no anchor capacity from embedment.

checks.title: Independent dimensions and deliberate locks
checks.requirement: Per-connector dimensions are independent except explicit shared physical-bolt coordinates/identity; enforce real alignment without inferring equal forces.

checks.title: View extents are not engineering dimensions
checks.requirement: Column display length/camera clipping does not alter physical lower-end plane, edge distance, centroidal load reference, panel restraint, engineering fingerprint or current design status.

checks.title: Offset reference and placement
checks.requirement: Column placement relative to report O is physical and source-bound; preserve exact generated moments when nonzero placement offsets are selected.

checks.title: One physical shank ID
checks.requirement: Represent a shared bolt once with interface/region IDs, ordered traversed zones and distinct terminal hardware; share references between connector cards, not duplicated bodies.

checks.title: Hollow ordered stack
checks.requirement: For common RHS bolts retain ANGLE / NEAR_WALL / CAVITY / FAR_WALL / ANGLE; cavity is free shank, not a resistance layer.

checks.title: Solid ordered stack
checks.requirement: For SRS use ANGLE / CONTINUOUS_SOLID / ANGLE and actual full grip; no virtual midplane washer or thin-plate thickness substitution.

checks.title: WI web ordered stack
checks.requirement: Preserve ANGLE / WEB / ANGLE with two actual interfaces; unequal interface vectors remain explicit and the common bolt is checked once per physical shaft section.

checks.title: WI flange ordered stack
checks.requirement: Preserve ANGLE / SELECTED_FLANGE; do not drill the opposite flange or web to fabricate a common-bolt arrangement.

checks.title: Opposite-grid mapping
checks.requirement: Local A reverses on opposite faces; alignment is checked in global coordinates, not equal array indices or copied signs. Mismatched opposite patterns fail geometry validation.

checks.title: Crossing shanks rejected
checks.requirement: Detect finite perpendicular shank and hole-envelope collisions inside hollow/solid columns; X-ray alone cannot establish clearance.

checks.title: No silent stagger
checks.requirement: Changing one elevation to cause a crossing returns specific validation reasons; do not shift, shorten, merge or delete another bolt without a user edit.

checks.title: Hardware containment and access
checks.requirement: Verify full washer/head/nut envelopes, seating surfaces, fillet clearance, column ends and assembly access. Exterior hardware only for hollow/solid common bolts.

checks.title: Source-bound long grip
checks.requirement: Preserve native fastener-grade/thread/grip applicability; long shanks need qualified section/bending response where required, not blind short-bolt capacity.

checks.title: Unequal wall and shaft reactions
checks.requirement: Read actual source-defined layer reactions/shaft-section vectors; no equal near/far wall reaction, additive duplicate planes or automatic doubled capacity.

checks.title: No hidden reinforcement
checks.requirement: Do not invent sleeves, backing plates, internal nuts, access holes, grout-filled cavities, base plates or stiffeners to make presets or strength checks work.

checks.title: Opposite connectors share only physical constraints
checks.requirement: Mirrored holes do not establish force symmetry; per-connector source wrenches remain distinct and load-case bound.

checks.title: Column material axes
checks.requirement: Column LW is vertical Z with actual per-region CW/TT; do not use horizontal angle extrusion direction for the column material lookup.

checks.title: Angle material axes
checks.requirement: Angle LW is local horizontal A; B is vertical member leaf, C is outward foot. Use proper frames and actual local references.

checks.title: Foundation attachment representation
checks.requirement: Vertical foot attachments use existing valid physical anchor representation; no invented nut below the pedestal, adhesive anchor behavior or anchor capacity.

checks.title: Right-hand input convention
checks.requirement: F_C=(Vx,Vy,N), M_C=(Mx,My,0), N positive uplift; use physical right-hand moments, not beam structural-major-moment sign conventions.

checks.title: Independent torsion boundary
checks.requirement: Reject nonzero user-input Mz at column centroid, retain reference-generated Mz and branch free moments.

checks.title: Native centroid identity
checks.requirement: All centered uniform symmetric reference sections have zero centroid offset; production uses baseline native centroid/fillets and actual placement.

checks.title: Exact total transport
checks.requirement: W_O uses F_O=QF_R, M_O=QM_R+(r_R-r_O) cross F_O; opposite reaction is its negative at the same reference.

checks.title: Proper frame transforms
checks.requirement: All connector rotations are determinant +1 and preserve norms/cross products; reflecting a face without correcting local axes fails.

checks.title: Native dependency equality
checks.requirement: Build Slice 7/8 and other reused-engine inputs independently in tests and compare native outputs exactly; do not copy the product adapter output back into its oracle.

checks.title: Proof versus serialization
checks.requirement: Keep native algebraic proofs, source-ledger closure and actual finite-serialization residuals separate; no residual copied from another stage, tolerance addition or redistribution.

checks.title: Member in-plane versus normal
checks.requirement: Retain FA,FB,MC as Slice 8 subset, FC,MA,MB as normal/contact complement; do not assign the complement zero.

checks.title: Wrench reference agrees with grid
checks.requirement: Use physical bolt coordinates and wrench reference in the same frame; prove physically different references change demand and consistent translations do not.

checks.title: Exact dual-unit identity
checks.requirement: Use existing quantities/units, original hole-source representation, normalized physical identity and native conversion behavior.

checks.title: Complete topology-bound source
checks.requirement: New complete-base response binds profile/solid shape, active face set, every bracket, shared shaft, materials, hardware, load/reference, contact and versioned applicability.

checks.title: Missing response is explicit
checks.requirement: For nonzero inputs without applicable complete response, provide valid total foundation action but no fabricated connector, per-bolt, wall or anchor demand.

checks.title: No production synthetic source
checks.requirement: Synthetic fixtures/qualified-integration doubles are test-only and unavailable from production presets/registry/UI; a typed reference is not qualification.

checks.title: Static balance is insufficient
checks.requirement: A source must have applicable analysis/qualification evidence beyond its own boolean flag and equilibrium; two equilibrated different allocations are not automatically acceptable.

checks.title: All active branches and direct contact
checks.requirement: Require exactly the active 2 or 4 branch IDs and a distinct direct-contact record or certified inactive state; omitted response is not zero.

checks.title: No dangling inactive branch
checks.requirement: Switching FOUR_XY to TWO_X/TWO_Y removes inactive branch geometry, loads/results and source bindings; reject extra branch IDs in response.

checks.title: Physical contact patches
checks.requirement: Compression-only pressure patches lie on actual WI/RHS/SRS end material; a net resultant at a centroid may lie over a void but is not a pressure patch.

checks.title: Contact signs and zero area
checks.requirement: Reject tensile compressive pressure, zero/negative patch area, unsupported tangential friction and patches in voids; do not abs/clip forces.

checks.title: No counted-twice contact
checks.requirement: Direct column contact is not inserted into both connector cores; a net foot wrench and its detailed anchors/contact are not added together twice.

checks.title: Common bolts are coupled
checks.requirement: Two independent angle certificates cannot establish complete shared-shank/wall response; couple all affected branches/bolts or retain missing coverage.

checks.title: Normal and secondary bending
checks.requirement: Require actual source-qualified bolt-axis demand, shaft sections/contact and secondary bending coverage as needed. An in-plane balance is not a normal response solver.

checks.title: Source changes invalidate bindings
checks.requirement: Profile, layout, dimensions, hardware, offsets, force sign/reference and source domain changes clear incompatible qualification; no silent interpolation.

checks.title: Per-bolt/source ownership
checks.requirement: Reject duplicate physical bolt IDs, mismatched faces, nonfinite inputs, unapproved field values, incomplete reaction arrays and missing nonzero components.

checks.title: Exact ledger recovery
checks.requirement: Source response uses accepted exact rational/finite-value proof contract; reject altered source values and preserve inherited projection diagnostics separately.

checks.title: Zero actions
checks.requirement: With no self-weight/preload/pretension, exact zero transfer may be proven separately; zero demand does not qualify future strength or stiffness.

checks.title: Load reversal uses new admissible state
checks.requirement: Pure input transport is antisymmetric; contact/bolt-tension active sets are not automatically negatives of a prior response.

checks.title: Response is not capacity
checks.requirement: Complete base response, body strength, local region capacity, bolt strength and end-zone interaction are separate authorizations; one cannot silently fill another.

checks.title: All three action cases source-present
checks.requirement: Execute 90 actual integrations: 15 geometry/layout configurations x combined compression, combined uplift reversal and pure biaxial x US/SI; use explicit applicable test sources only.

checks.title: All active Slice 7 cores
checks.requirement: Execute two or four unchanged cores using each complete qualified member wrench; retain member, heel and foot references and all local moments.

checks.title: FRP body/instep coverage
checks.requirement: Use native instep shear only for its extrusion-axis shear scope and separate full-wrench qualified body checks; vertical axial transfer is not instep shear by definition.

checks.title: Native bolt strengths
checks.requirement: When demand and source allow, invoke actual bolt shear/tension/interaction checks with source/thread/grip metadata; preserve ASTM F593 source-pending limitations.

checks.title: Shared physical bolt check
checks.requirement: Combine compatible per-plane/shaft-section demands in one physical-bolt record without summing duplicate external reactions or doubling resistance.

checks.title: Actual local regions
checks.requirement: Check angle uprights, selected WI web/flanges or RHS walls with actual material/force directions and loaded interfaces; SRS effective sections must have applicable authority.

checks.title: Local limit states retained
checks.requirement: Preserve all applicable bearing/net tension/shear-out/cleavage/block-shear/pull-through outputs and source limitations; no blanket zero-demand shortcut for unresolved sharing.

checks.title: End-zone interaction separate
checks.requirement: Independent wall/bolt checks do not prove combined column-end-zone/junction/local bending adequacy; show qualified interaction coverage separately.

checks.title: Full foundation remains external
checks.requirement: Do not substitute metal through-bolt strength for anchor system/concrete bearing/pullout/breakout/foundation strength/stability. Group wrenches are handoffs only.

checks.title: Full column remains external
checks.requirement: No new Chapter 4/5/6 global member design or use of view length as unbraced length; stiffness/rotation/full-strength remain not evaluated.

checks.title: Status precedence without canned FAIL
checks.requirement: Geometry invalidity precedes actual evaluated failure; missing response/capacity remains explicit. No default inherited FAIL or ordinary whole-base PASS.

checks.title: Failure trace must explain FAIL
checks.requirement: Every numerical FAIL has an actual native failed-check/reason and correct input fingerprint; preserve subordinate failures and missing sources separately.

checks.title: Preview resistance count zero
checks.requirement: Preview resolves geometry, total transport and permitted source-bound demand validation only; every resistance/provider capacity call remains explicit-design-only.

checks.title: Additive integration
checks.requirement: Add new product routes/types/exports and exact route inventories; do not implement through fake Stage 4.4 Angle profiles or mutate old request contracts.

checks.title: One canonical state
checks.requirement: Sidebar and editable action labels share the exact current input state; response provenance binds normalized input and topology.

checks.title: Topology selectors clear incompatible state
checks.requirement: WI/RHS/SRS and two-axis/four selectors rebuild from authoritative backend records without hidden preserved bolts/loads or duplicated assemblies.

checks.title: Square and nonsquare presets
checks.requirement: All five presets times three layouts load in US and SI with feasible geometry; label them construction examples, not passing designs.

checks.title: Shared group editors
checks.requirement: Show independent connector dimensions and explicitly shared physical-bolt pair coordinates; do not duplicate contradictory editable copies.

checks.title: Readable input groups
checks.requirement: Member bolts and foundation attachments occupy full-width sidebar groups; washer/nut/strength/source inputs are labeled with engineering terms.

checks.title: Live valid load edit
checks.requirement: From a valid preset change one load; inspect normalized request, accepted response and rendered signed arrow/value before running design. No old load in current scene.

checks.title: Live valid hardware edit
checks.requirement: Individually verify column, bracket, member-bolt and foundation-attachment changes against backend snapshot and rendered actual geometry.

checks.title: Prominent invalid LAST VALID
checks.requirement: Retained scene is visibly LAST VALID adjacent to/inside viewer; hide stale load arrows, show actual validation reasons near fields and block design.

checks.title: Automatic recovery
checks.requirement: Correct invalid geometry and require automatic current preview replacement, restored current arrows and stale prior design; no manual reload required.

checks.title: Input parsing and intermediate edits
checks.requirement: Empty/sign-only fields remain editable invalid intermediate state without crash or zero coercion; finite/boolean/count validation stays backend controlled.

checks.title: Request race protection
checks.requirement: Slow/superseded/aborted preview or design responses cannot overwrite newer input, source or result state; test valid-invalid-valid rapid sequence.

checks.title: Presentation-only edits
checks.requirement: Orbit, X-ray, fit, overlay and view-length changes do not rerun design or change engineering identity; display-length refresh is a presentation snapshot update.

checks.title: Source absence usable
checks.requirement: Render actual geometry and required total wrench with useful incomplete-source trace; do not label the ordinary source-absent screen a full design verification.

checks.title: Source-present readable trace
checks.requirement: Test-only integration must render two/four member/heel/foot wrenches, coupled shafts, contact, applicable local checks and missing scopes without duplicate forces.

checks.title: Scene color/type identity
checks.requirement: Concrete pedestal uses its actual support appearance; WI, hollow and solid geometry are visually distinguishable without inventing bounding-box solids.

checks.title: Hardware X-ray and views
checks.requirement: Use top, both sides and X-ray to inspect every shared shank, hollow cavity and nonintersecting perpendicular pair; no visible floating foot or missing hardware.

checks.title: Action labels editable and clear
checks.requirement: Labels remain distinct for N,Vx,Vy,Mx,My, proper signed arrows; no overlap that blocks the intended editor and no stale labels under LAST VALID.

checks.title: No fictitious anchors/contact graphics
checks.requirement: Do not draw numerical individual anchor reactions or pressure contours without applicable accepted response; unknown response remains visually unavailable.

checks.title: Independent real-browser evidence
checks.requirement: Run actual app root/selector and APIs in approved browser, inspect console/network and capture representative valid/invalid/recovery cases for all modes; do not rely only on mocked tests.

checks.title: Twenty-four independent fixtures
checks.requirement: Recompute all F45-01..F45-24 independently using exact rational reference algebra; these never become production qualification sources.

checks.title: 360 source-absent integrations
checks.requirement: Execute 5 geometry presets x 3 layouts x 12 loads x 2 units; validate whole product normalization/geometry/total transport/status/noninvention.

checks.title: 90 source-present integrations
checks.requirement: Execute full product source-present paths in 15 geometries/layouts x 3 named actions x 2 units; response validation, native body/bolt/local checks cannot be stubs.

checks.title: Normal source negative tests
checks.requirement: Mutate source signs, physical IDs, matrix orientation, offsets, inactive branch and shaft/contact fields; ensure correct fail-closed response without fabricated demand.

checks.title: Real-native integration oracles
checks.requirement: Construct direct native calls from actual request and source geometry independently of product output; preserve each dependency independent golden suite.

checks.title: Native capacity failure visible
checks.requirement: Provide test-only sufficient and insufficient qualified capacity conditions without changing production material/defaults; verify native selection and trace completeness.

checks.title: Zero and degenerate group coverage
checks.requirement: Check zero load and one-bolt/zero-J applicability through the accepted engine; a nonzero independent moment in a zero-J model remains unsupported.

checks.title: Display-unit and permutation invariance
checks.requirement: Equivalent US/SI and stable physical-ID reorderings preserve engineering identity; real face/physical hole changes alter source binding.

checks.title: Preflight all legacy patterns
checks.requirement: Before implementation, project full planned change set through current scope/route/source-prefix guards; consolidate same-pattern tests-only repairs without changing historical hashes.

checks.title: No silent coverage loss
checks.requirement: All tests and coverage thresholds retained; maintain configured 100% coverage, static checks, build and audits. Baseline counts 3963 backend/710 frontend are reference counts, not a hard upper bound.

checks.title: Historical/source guard successor safety
checks.requirement: Anchor old identities to immutable evidence; permit only recorded Stage 4.5 changes in current scope; add historical tamper and future-successor probes without global path wildcards.

checks.title: Scope inventory and historical blobs
checks.requirement: Enumerate new product/additive glue/test/governance files and preserve every other baseline blob; no workflow/dependency/frozen engineering change.

checks.title: No licensed/generated artifacts
checks.requirement: Commit no licensed PDFs, screenshots, logs, secrets, node_modules, virtual environments or generated coverage/build output; only controlled records and reviewed sources.

checks.title: Bounded timing and environment handling
checks.requirement: Use approved per-test timeout/rerun and trusted module-invocation alternatives only under diagnosed conditions; no security-policy bypass or removed QA.

checks.title: Precommit checkpoint
checks.requirement: Review explicit staged paths, hashes, whitespace, source-prefix preservation and clean-index/worktree boundaries before exactly one normal implementation commit.

checks.title: Correct commit lineage
checks.requirement: Normally create count119 subject feat: add W/I RHS SRS column moment bases. Never amend or rewrite a published baseline; only bounded postpublish timeout successor changes count.

checks.title: True object-isolated verification
checks.requirement: Fresh depth-one --no-local --no-tags/no-alternates/no-shared-history clone of exact candidate; one reachable commit, complete QA and clean tree. No remote history needed by tests.

checks.title: Authorized exact destination push
checks.requirement: After local/browser/isolated QA, push exact unchanged candidate normally and non-force to origin main for baraa-misto/frp-master-connection; no tags.

checks.title: Direct hosted acceptance
checks.requirement: Require Backend Ubuntu/Windows and Frontend Ubuntu/Windows results for the exact published candidate. Hosted evidence is obtained after push; never infer it.

checks.title: Owner acceptance remains pending
checks.requirement: Leave final application running at reported localhost URL with process/session IDs; report actual scope/limitations. Do not freeze Stage 4.5, claim all moments complete, or begin 316SS.
